_about: Data of the day_street set: the night_street geometry by day (D12), light preset dayExterior. Read by tools/build_props.py (marks, front), src/episode/sets.tsx and tools/check_render.py (light_kind). Marks = feet positions on the ground (meters).

mark_notes.lantern_spot: where Bram stands in v3: his raised pole touches the lantern seen from the v3 hook camera
mark_notes.across_window: not a feet mark: the window across the street (camera aim point)
mark_notes.street_far: middle of the street, far side: film it with camera front [0, 0, -1] for the facades across + sky

_camera_bounds: box the camera must stay inside (walls, facades); presets shorten their distance to fit
